message.translation: 在放大图上勾出每个像素的边界。倍率低时自动不画，否则网格线会盖住像素本身。

message.source: Show the color-copy shortcut under the readings. Off makes the magnifier shorter.
message.translation: 在数值下方显示复制颜色的快捷键。关掉后放大镜会变矮一些。

message.source: Show the picked color in the top-right corner of the magnified view.
message.translation: 在放大图右上角显示当前取到的颜色。

message.translation: 所选文件夹已经是当前位置。

message.source: Please choose a folder outside the current clipboard images folder.
message.translation: 请选择当前剪贴板图片文件夹之外的位置。

message.translation: 所选文件夹已包含剪贴板数据。要用当前数据替换吗？

message.translation: 关闭当前剪贴板数据库失败。

message.translation: 剪贴板数据位置已更改，但旧文件仍被占用，暂时无法删除。重启应用后可以手动删除。\n{error}

message.source: Clipboard data moved, but reopening the database failed. Please restart the app.
message.translation: 剪贴板数据已移动，但重新打开数据库失败。请重启应用。

message.source: No clipboard data files were found to move.
message.translation: 没有找到可移动的剪贴板数据文件。

Font and size of application windows.
message.translation: 应用窗口的字体与尺寸。

message.translation: 隐藏后依然可以拖动边角调整选区。

Drag the handle to reorder. Use the drop-down to change visibility.

message.source: No QR code or barcode found
message.translation: 未识别到二维码或条形码

message.source: Make sure the whole code is inside the selection.
message.translation: 请确认码完整地框在选区内。

message.source: No text found in the selection.
message.translation: 选区内没有识别到文字。

message.source: This build does not include the text recognition engine.
message.translation: 当前版本不包含文字识别引擎。

message.source: Checked formats show on the magnifier. The first one is what the copy shortcut puts on the clipboard — drag it to the top to change that.
message.translation: 勾选的格式会显示在放大镜上。排在第一位的那个才是按键复制到剪贴板的内容——想换就把它拖到最前面。

message.source: Already in use by another app.
Only in screenshot, pin and clipboard windows
message.translation: 只在截图、钉图和剪贴板窗口里生效

message.source: Copy the recognized text straight to the clipboard instead of opening the result window.
message.translation: 识别完成后把文字直接复制到剪贴板，不弹出结果窗口。

message.source: When only one QR code or barcode is found, copy its content instead of opening the result window. Multiple codes still open it.
message.translation: 只识别到一个二维码或条形码时直接复制内容，不弹出结果窗口；识别到多个码时仍会弹出。

message.source: Copy directly if only one code
message.translation: 只有一个码时直接复制
